name: proporacle-mobile
description: Capacitor shell: canonical mode loads live Railway (server.url). Bundled www/ is fallback via sync:bundle.

scripts.bundle:android: npm run bundle:www && npm run sync:bundle
scripts.sync:bundle: PowerShell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PROPORACLE_MOBILE_MODE='bundled'; Remove-Item Env:\PROPORACLE_SERVER_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path 'android/app/src/main/assets/public' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; npm run copy:android"
scripts.sync:remote: PowerShell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item Env:\PROPORACLE_MOBILE_MODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $u = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PROPORACLE_SERVER_URL','Process'); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($u)) { $env:PROPORACLE_SERVER_URL = 'https://web-production-f280f.up.railway.app' } elseif (-not ($u.StartsWith('https://'))) { throw 'Remote UI must use https://' }; npm run sync:android"
scripts.sync:url: PowerShell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$u=$env:npm_config_url; if (-not $u) { throw 'Usage: npm run sync:url --url=http://IP:PORT'; }; $env:PROPORACLE_SERVER_URL=$u; npm run sync:android"
scripts.clean-deploy:android: npm run sync:android && npm run clean:android && npm run open:android
